business_scope.primary_industry_name: International Student Placement and Golden Visa Residence Advisory

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Viet Nam (unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state corporate registration distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (socialist-oriented market economy; codified statutes, decrees, circulars; unitary system)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: EU-Viet Nam Free Trade Agreement (EVFTA), effective 1 August 2020
EU-Viet Nam Investment Protection Agreement (EVIPA) - signed 30 June 2019, ratified by Viet Nam, not yet in force pending EU Member State ratifications
Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP), in force for Viet Nam since 14 January 2019
Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP), in force since 1 January 2022
ASEAN Comprehensive Investment Agreement (ACIA) and ASEAN Framework Agreement on Services (AFAS)
Viet Nam - Japan Investment Agreement (2003) and Japan-Viet Nam DTA (1992)
Viet Nam - Republic of Korea Investment Agreement (2003) and Korea-Viet Nam DTA (1994); Viet Nam-Korea Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (VKFTA, 2015)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14, Articles 22-35 and 166-197 (limited liability company formation, charter capital contribution, Members' Council, and legal representation); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, Articles 22-38 (investment registration and conditional business lines); Government Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on Enterprise Registration, Articles 21-34 and 43-48; Government Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP detailing the Law on Investment, Articles 36-49; Government Decree No. 46/2017/ND-CP as amended on education cooperation, Articles 96-102 (study-abroad consultancy conditions).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registration Office (BRO) of the Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) under the Ministry of Planning and Investment (MPI), operating through the National Enterprise Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) and the one-stop division of the Provincial Administrative Center (Trung tâm Phục vụ Hành chính công).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp) filed together with the Investment Registration Certificate dossier (Giấy chứng nhận đăng ký đầu tư); the ERC and IRC collectively form the statutory incorporation instruments.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is imposed on a service LLC under Vietnamese law; charter capital is freely agreed by the members and recorded in the Charter. The foreign investor must nevertheless demonstrate sufficient financial capacity at the IRC application stage. Charter capital must be fully contributed to a bank account in Viet Nam within 90 days from issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate (Decree 31/2021/ND-CP, Article 47). No escrow account is mandatory for incorporation, but the capital contribution account is required, and defaulting members forfeit rights to the un-paid portion.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLUTION OF THE OWNER / MEMBERS' COUNCIL OF [COMPANY NAME] LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY

Adopted on [date], at [place], pursuant to the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14, the Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, and Investment Registration Certificate No. [IRC number] issued on [date] by the Department of Planning and Investment.

RECITALS:
(i) The Company is a foreign-invested limited liability company established under the laws of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam with charter capital of VND [____] (approximately USD [____]);
(ii) The registered business lines include ISIC 7810 international student placement, study-abroad consulting, and immigration/golden-visa residence advisory services;
(iii) The members have subscribed to the charter capital ratios stated in the Company Charter and the List of Members.

NOW, THEREFORE, THE FOLLOWING RESOLUTIONS ARE ADOPTED:

1. CHARTER ADOPTION: The Company Charter consisting of [__] articles, as annexed, is ratified and shall be submitted to the Business Registration Office with the Application for Enterprise Registration. The Charter prevails over all internal policies.

2. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION: The charter capital is fixed at VND [____], subscribed as follows: Member [A]: [__]%; Member [B]: [__]%. Each member confirms that its contributions shall be fully paid into the company capital contribution account within ninety (90) days from the issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate, failing which the defaulting member loses rights to its unpaid contributed portion.

3. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION: The registered office is established at [full address], Ward [__], District [__], [Province/City], Viet Nam. The General Director is authorized to conclude the lease, to register the address, and, if necessary, to relocate the office upon subsequent members' approval.

4. OFFICER APPOINTMENTS: (a) Chairman of the Members' Council: [Name] (passport No. [___]); (b) General Director and Legal Representative: [Name] (passport No. [___]), vested with statutory representative authority before courts, state agencies, banks, and third parties; (c) Deputy Legal Representative (if any): [Name] (passport No. [___]); (d) Chief Accountant: [Name] (accounting certificate No. [___]).

5. IMPLEMENTATION DELEGATION: The Chairman and the General Director are jointly and severally authorized to execute the Enterprise Registration application, national portal publication, seal specimen declaration, bank account opening, tax registration, e-invoice activation, and the study-abroad consultancy licensing before the Department of Education and Training.

6. SCOPE OF BUSINESS APPROVAL: The Company may operate exclusively within the approved conditional business scope of study-abroad consulting, international student placement, and immigration-visa advisory services, with all fees received through escrow or wire transfer in accordance with applicable anti-money-laundering rules.

7. GENERAL PROVISIONS: This Resolution is effective immediately and a certified copy shall be kept at the registered office and submitted to the DPI upon request. It may be amended only by a subsequent resolution of the Members' Council.

ADOPTED UNANIMOUSLY on [date] at [place].

Signed: Chairman of the Members' Council .............................................
Signed: General Director / Legal Representative .............................................

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) for the Foreign-Invested Project
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Registration Agency of the Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI), through the National Foreign Investment Information System (Invest Vietnam) or direct submission at the DPI one-stop division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The foreign investor submits a formal application for investment registration using the statutory form, accompanied by a project description covering study-abroad consulting, international student placement, and immigration-visa advisory services. The dossier must identify the location of the registered office, the proposed charter capital, the foreign ownership percentage, and demonstrated compliance with conditional business-line requirements for study-abroad consultancy (qualified facilities and personnel under Decree 46/2017/ND-CP). The DPI verifies legal validity and content; within 3 working days of receipt, it issues a written request for amendment if incomplete; upon full compliance it grants the IRC within 15 working days. The IRC is the precondition for the Enterprise Registration Certificate.
required_dossiers: Application for Investment Registration (Form A.I.1 of Decree 31/2021/ND-CP)
Project proposal / feasibility description containing the study-abroad and immigration-visa advisory business plan
Lease agreement, memorandum of understanding, or land-use right documents proving location of the registered office
Financial statements, bank reference, or commitment letter proving availability of the foreign capital
Certified copy of the investor's passport or certificate of incorporation (legalized/apostilled as required)
Documents proving satisfaction of conditions for the conditional business line (facility dossier, qualification of the person in charge of consultancy)
Power of attorney for the designated focal contact, if the investor does not sign directly
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the dossier is queried, the investor cures the deficiency within the period stated by the DPI (normally 10 working days). If the application is refused, the investor may file a written complaint with the Director of the DPI under the Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13 within 30 days of receipt of the refusal, or re-submit a corrected dossier; a subsequent administrative lawsuit before the Provincial Administrative Court is available within 1 year.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Application for Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office (BRO) of the Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI), through the National Enterprise Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) or in-person at the Provincial Administrative Center
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the IRC, the legal representative submits the Application for Enterprise Registration together with the approved company name, the Company Charter, the List of Members, and the personal legal documents of each member and legal representative. The BRO performs a formal and legality review against Decree 01/2021/ND-CP, including name-conflict checks and charter capital consistency with the IRC. On a complete and valid dossier, the BRO issues the Enterprise Registration Certificate within 3 working days, which simultaneously grants the enterprise code and the tax identification number (TIN). The company acquires legal personality on the date of ERC issuance.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration (Form No. 1-1 or 1-2 of Decree 01/2021/ND-CP)
Company Charter of the Limited Liability Company (original, signed by all members)
List of Members (with capital contribution ratios and signatures of all members)
Certified copy of the Investment Registration Certificate
Certified copies of passports / certificates of incorporation of all members
List of authorized representatives, Chairman of the Members' Council, and General Director with their personal legal documents
For multi-member LLC: subscription statements or resolutions of members on establishment; for single-member LLC: Decision of the Owner on establishment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the BRO queries or rejects the application, the applicant receives a written explanation of deficiencies; correction must be completed within 10 working days. A rejection on substantive grounds may be appealed by complaint to the DPI Director under Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13, or by an administrative lawsuit before the Provincial Administrative Court. A name conflict is cured by selecting an alternative name and resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of Establishment Contents on the National Enterprise Registration Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Enterprise Registration Portal (operated by the Ministry of Planning and Investment) and the provincial Business Registration Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days from the date of the ERC, the company (directly or through an authorized agent) submits the publication content electronically to the National Enterprise Registration Portal and pays the publication fee (currently VND 100,000, approximately USD 4). The portal publicly posts the enterprise code, company name in Vietnamese, business scope, charter capital, registered office address, legal representatives, and ownership structure. The publication confirmation page is retained in the corporate record book and used as proof for subsequent bank and licensing procedures.
required_dossiers: Electronic or scanned copy of the Enterprise Registration Certificate
Publication fee voucher paid via the national payment gateway
Publication content text in the format prescribed by Decree 01/2021/ND-CP
Authorized signatory's identification document for the submission
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late or non-publication is sanctioned under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP, Article 28, with administrative fines of VND 10,000,000 to 15,000,000; the company immediately cures by completing the online publication. If the portal rejects or queries the content, the filer amends and resubmits within 5 working days; technical defects are remedied by contacting the national registration support desk.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Seal Creation, Seal Specimen Declaration, and Opening of Capital Contribution Bank Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial bank (for capital contribution/settlement account); National Enterprise Registration Portal and provincial Business Registration Office (for seal specimen declaration); licensed seal engraving establishment (for physical seal production)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The company resolves on the seal design and engages a licensed seal engraving establishment. Under Decree 01/2021/ND-CP, Article 32, the company itself declares the seal specimen electronically on the National Enterprise Registration Portal, which posts it publicly; prior police approval is no longer required. Simultaneously, the General Director opens the corporate settlement and capital contribution account at a licensed commercial bank in Viet Nam, supplying the ERC, IRC, charter, and seal specimen. The members deposit their capital contributions before the 90-day statutory deadline; bank payment records are preserved to evidence the contribution, and the contributed capital may be adjusted with the BRO as needed.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate and Investment Registration Certificate (certified copies)
Resolution of the Members' Council / Owner authorizing bank account opening and seal creation
Seal sample and seal specimen declaration form submitted on the National Enterprise Registration Portal
Bank and customer due-diligence forms including lease agreement and premises records of the company
List of capital contributions and bank transfer/receipt confirmations of each member
Passport copies of the General Director and signatories for bank KYC
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries corporate documents, the company supplies supplemental resolutions and updated registry records; a refusal is cured by applying to another licensed bank. Late seal declaration or failure to declare the seal specimen attracts administrative fines under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP; it is cured by immediate online declaration. A member failing to contribute within 90 days forfeits its right to the unpaid capital portion and is liable to the company for resulting damages, whereupon the company files an adjustment of charter capital with the BRO.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, VAT Method Election, and E-Invoice Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Tax Department / General Department of Taxation via the national e-tax portal (thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn) and the e-invoice system (hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The enterprise code allocated with the ERC automatically constitutes the tax identification number (TIN). The legal representative must complete the taxpayer information update, elect the VAT calculation method (credit or direct), and register the e-invoice templates within statutory periods after establishment, in line with Law on Tax Administration No. 38/2019/QH14, Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC, and Decree 123/2020/ND-CP. The company also registers its bank account details, signatory hierarchy for electronic tax declarations, and the list of e-invoice templates; after issuance of the certificate of e-invoice registration, the company activates devices and issues invoices for all fee payments, including escrow and wire-transfer based payments from overseas clients.
required_dossiers: Tax registration declaration form (Form 03/ĐK-TCT)
VAT method selection form (Form 06/GTGT)
Enterprise Registration Certificate and Investment Registration Certificate (certified copies)
Charter capital contribution confirmation with bank account details
List of e-invoice templates and invoice denomination (Form 05/GTGT)
Power of attorney and passport copy of the legal representative for e-tax account activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the taxpayer profile is locked or queried, the company cures via the e-tax portal by submitting the missing declarations; failure to file or late filing triggers fines under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP. The company may submit a written explanation to the Tax Sub-Department within 30 days of any administrative decision, may request reconsideration, or may appeal to the Director of the Provincial Tax Department.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Licensing of the Conditional Study-Abroad Consultancy and Immigration-Visa Advisory Operation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Department of Education and Training (DOET); for inter-provincial or cross-border program placements, the Department of Student Affairs of the Ministry of Education and Training (MOET)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Because study-abroad consulting is a conditional business line, the company applies to the DOET for the Certificate of Registered Study-Abroad Consultancy Business under Decree 46/2017/ND-CP, Articles 96-102. The application is accompanied by proof of lawful incorporation, the qualification of the person in charge of consultancy, personnel CVs, the facility lease, and a facility description. The DOET verifies the dossier and the physical premise within 10 working days; on satisfaction, it issues the certificate. The company is thereafter obliged to maintain the conditions continuously, keep student records for the statutory period, publish support information truthfully, and update the DOET on changes in premises or responsible officers. Immigration-visa advisory activities do not require a separate license but must comply with the Civil Code on service contracts and data protection rules.
required_dossiers: Application for the issuance of the Certificate of Registered Study-Abroad Consultancy Business
Certified copy of the Enterprise Registration Certificate containing the study-abroad consulting business line
Curriculum vitae and degree certificates of the director / person in charge of consultancy
List and qualification documents of consulting staff
Certified copy of the lease agreement for the consulting office premises
Photographs and layout diagram of facilities, equipment, and safety equipment
Written commitment to comply with the Law on Education and Decree 46/2017/ND-CP conditions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is refused, the DOET issues a written refusal stating the legal grounds. The company may cure the deficiencies and reapply, file a complaint with the Chairman of the Provincial People's Committee under Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13 within 30 days, or initiate an administrative lawsuit within 1 year. Suspension of the certificate due to non-compliance is remedied by restoring the conditions and petitioning the DOET for reinstatement.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Provincial Department of Education and Training (DOET) for conditional education-service licensing; the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) for verification of the conditional study-abroad consulting business line in the IRC/ERC; no industrial manufacturing ministry is applicable because the operation is a professional office-based service.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Giấy chứng nhận đăng ký kinh doanh dịch vụ tư vấn du học (Certificate of Registered Study-Abroad Consultancy Business) issued by the Provincial Department of Education and Training under Decree No. 46/2017/ND-CP, as amended; the immigration-visa advisory segment operates under the ERC business line of advisory services without a separate national license.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE) — delegated to the Provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category IV (office-based service activity with no industrial production). Under Law on Environmental Protection No. 72/2020/QH14 and Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP, the study-abroad consulting office is not required to prepare a full EIA Report or an Environmental Impact Assessment; only simplified environmental protection registration (Đăng ký môi trường) applies where the office lease and premises management require it.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Domestic wastewater generated at the office must comply with QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT before discharge into the municipal sewerage system; general industrial emission limits under QCVN 19:2009/BTNMT are not triggered because no production or combustion equipment is operated; solid waste must be segregated at source, stored in labeled containers, and transferred to licensed urban environmental service companies in accordance with Decree 08/2022/ND-CP; air-conditioning refrigerants must comply with the Montreal Protocol and Vietnam ozone-layer protection regulations; electrical safety and energy efficiency standards apply to office equipment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety: the office premises must obtain fire prevention and fighting (PCCC) settlement, namely a written certification of fire safety eligibility (Giấy chứng nhận đủ điều kiện an toàn về PCCC) or a written acceptance of fire safety requirements issued by the provincial Fire Prevention and Fighting Police under the Law on Fire Prevention and Fighting No. 27/2001/QH10 (as amended) and Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP, including fire doors, extinguishers, emergency lighting, and evacuation plans. Structural clearance: occupancy of the rented office is evidenced by the building owner's construction completion certificate and compliance with local building-code requirements for offices and administrative premises. Occupational clearance: the workplace must comply with the Law on Occupational Safety and Health No. 84/2015/QH13, including workplace risk assessment, annual employee health checks, first-aid provisions, fire drills, and mandatory personal protective equipment rules; a copy of the safety-eligibility certificate and occupational health records is kept at the registered office for inspection by the Department of Labor, Invalids and Social Affairs.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế), Ministry of Finance of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam — Central portal: www.gdt.gov.vn; e-filing portal: thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn; e-invoice portal: hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn; National Public Service Portal: dichvucong.gov.vn; business registration portal: dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested LLC is automatically assigned its Tax Identification Number (Mã số thuế, MST) upon issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) by the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI). The MST is identical to the 10-digit Enterprise Code and is generated ex officio via the National Business Registration Portal. Post-incorporation compliance steps: (i) upload the electronic tax registration dossier through thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn within 10 working days of ERC issuance; (ii) obtain a Class-3 digital signature certificate (chữ ký số) from an approved certification authority (e.g., Viettel-CA, VNPT-CA, FPT-CA) for e-filing and e-invoice transmission; (iii) notify the tax office of the corporate seal specimen and legal representative; (iv) register the opening of a Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) at an authorized commercial bank for inbound equity and foreign-currency receipt; and (v) register for Social Insurance, Health Insurance, and Unemployment Insurance with the provincial Social Insurance Agency using the same MST. No separate registration with the GDT is required to obtain the TIN; the MST is the single taxpayer identifier for all corporate taxes, customs, e-invoices, and social insurance contributions.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Viet Nam does not provide a check-the-box or US-style pass-through regime; an LLC is conclusively a separate CIT and VAT taxpayer. Statutory elections available to the LLC include: (i) election to apply the deemed input-VAT credit method under Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC (5% of output VAT for goods and 3% for services at the 10% VAT rate) where actual input credit tracing is impractical; (ii) election to file consolidated monthly VAT and provisional CIT declarations for dependent branches located within the same provincial taxing district; (iii) election of quarterly provisional CIT instalments at not less than 80% of the estimated annual liability, with a finalisation return by the 90th day after fiscal year-end; (iv) election to enter a unilateral, bilateral, or multilateral Advance Pricing Arrangement (APA) for transfer-pricing certainty; (v) election to claim an investment incentive exemption/reduction of CIT for projects located in eligible industrial parks or under new investment law thresholds; and (vi) election by a foreign contractor supplying services to the LLC to apply the Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT) mixed or turnover-based withholding method, which interacts with the LLC's obligation to withhold at source.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (Thuế Giá Trị Gia Tăng — GTGT), governed by Law No. 13/2008/QH12 as amended by Law No. 31/2013/QH13 and Law No. 71/2014/QH13; implementing guidance in Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC, Circular 26/2015/TT-BTC, and Decree 123/2020/ND-CP
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No VAT registration threshold applies to incorporated LLCs — every LLC is mandatorily VAT-registered upon ERC issuance irrespective of revenue. Unincorporated household businesses and individual entrepreneurs are exempt from VAT registration and output tax collection if annual turnover from VAT-liable goods/services does not exceed VND 100,000,000 (approximately USD 4,100). For the ISIC 7810 study-abroad/immigration-consulting scope, the LLC must register for the standard VAT method (khấu trừ) rather than the deemed method, given its corporate status and anticipated input invoices.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All enterprises must issue fully electronic invoices under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC. The LLC must apply to the GDT for an e-invoice issuing code (kỳ hóa đơn) and transmit each invoice to the GDT e-invoice portal (hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn) in real time at issuance. Two types of e-invoices exist: (a) invoices bearing the GDT computer-generated tax-authority code (hóa đơn có mã của cơ quan thuế), which require pre-issuance data transmission and digital stamping approval; and (b) invoices without tax-authority codes, used mainly by in-house circulation and suitable only for enterprises holding the GDT's permission. In practice, service-consulting LLCs use coded e-invoices. A qualified digital signature (chữ ký số) from an authorised CA is mandatory on each invoice. E-invoice data must be preserved for 10 years; non-compliant invoice issuance can result in suspension of invoice codes and severe administrative penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The 0% VAT rate applies to services exported to foreign organisations or individuals that are consumed entirely outside Viet Nam, pursuant to Article 9(2) of Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC and Circular 26/2015/TT-BTC. For ISIC 7810 study-abroad placement and immigration/visa consulting, zero-rating is available only when all cumulative conditions are satisfied: (i) the contracting counterparty is a person resident outside Viet Nam — e.g., a foreign university, overseas foundation, or non-resident applicant; (ii) the service is contractually rendered, performed, and delivered abroad; (iii) the end-beneficiary and actual consumption occur wholly offshore; (iv) payment is received in freely convertible foreign currency from abroad; and (v) the service is not one of the statutorily excluded categories (e.g., reinsurance, transportation, technology export restrictions). Critically, advisory services provided to Vietnamese-resident students or parents — even if ultimately facilitating overseas study or visa acquisition — are domestic standard-rated supplies at 10% VAT, not zero-rated. Mixed contracts must segregate domestic and export elements; a single contract containing both domestic and offshore deliverables is generally standard-rated in its entirety unless separately invoiced and substantiated.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Executed service agreement/contract with the foreign counterparty expressly identifying the cross-border nature of the supply, place of performance, and overseas consumption
E-invoice issued under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP bearing the 0% VAT rate and GDT invoice code

Foreign-currency inward remittance certificate or bank credit advice evidencing crediting of export service consideration to the LLC's DICA or a permitted foreign-currency account at an authorised bank

Notarised/legalised certificate or formal declaration of non-resident tax status of the foreign service recipient (e.g., foreign tax ID registration, certificate of incorporation, or overseas address proof)
Service delivery report and work-product documentation (e.g., submitted visa dossiers, university admission applications lodged abroad) demonstrating performance and consumption outside Viet Nam
Internal transfer-pricing call memo confirming the contractual terms align with arm's length substance
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The GDT and local tax departments conduct targeted horizontal audits of zero-rated service exporters claiming input-VAT refunds, with particular focus on professional-services enterprises. Adverse determinations trigger: (i) VAT reassessment at the 10% standard rate on the full invoice amount, plus late-payment interest of 0.03% per day calculated for the period from the original filing date (statutory assessment period: 10 years for incorrect declarations and 5 years for omission under Law No. 38/2019/QH14); (ii) administrative fines under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP — for under-declaration, 10%-20% of the understated tax; for fraudulent tax evasion, 1 to 3 times the evaded tax amount (minimum sanction VND 5,000,000 for individuals, doubled for organisations); (iii) clawback of any previously refunded input VAT, together with interest, and denial of refund eligibility for a 12-24-month bar period if the refund-regime adverse-conclusion criteria are met; (iv) criminal prosecution under Article 200 of the Penal Code 2015 (as amended 2017) where the evaded amount is VND 100,000,000 or more, with fines up to VND 4,500,000,000 or imprisonment of up to 7 years for organized, sophisticated, or repeated schemes; (v) civil and administrative sanctions by the State Bank of Viet Nam for violation of the 180-day export-earnings repatriation obligation under the Foreign Exchange Ordinance 06/2015/PL-UBTVQH13 and Circular 15/2016/TT-NHNN, including fines up to VND 200,000,000 and compulsory repatriation; and (vi) revocation of the enterprise's e-invoice code, and public blacklisting in the GDT's non-compliance notice where systematic zero-rating abuse is found.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) – Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam. The SBV is the exclusive central monetary authority and foreign-exchange administrator for the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam. Its regulatory command chain for this blueprint comprises the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange No. 28/2005/PL-UBTVQH11 as amended by Law No. 70/2014/QH13; Decree No. 70/2014/ND-CP on foreign-exchange control; Circular No. 02/2021/TT-NHNN on foreign-exchange administration of foreign investment activities in Vietnam; Circular No. 15/2015/TT-NHNN on foreign-exchange transactions between credit institutions and customers; Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15 (effective 1 March 2023); Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP on implementation of the Law on Investment with respect to outbound investment; and Decree No. 88/2019/ND-CP on administrative sanctions in the monetary and banking sector.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vietnamese dong (VND) is not a freely convertible currency; the SBV operates a managed floating exchange-rate regime with an official daily central rate. Current-account transactions are fully convertible in administrative practice: a foreign-invested enterprise may receive and pay cross-border service revenues and expenses (educational consultancy fees, international student placement commissions, tuition deposits, and application disbursements to foreign universities) through a licensed credit institution without prior SBV case-by-case approval, provided each remittance is supported by an underlying contract/invoice, carries a documented purpose code, and passes through an authorized bank account (Direct Investment Capital Account for capital flows, Foreign Currency Account for current-account service flows). The capital account remains restricted. Inward equity contributions, shareholder-loan drawdowns, and outward profit/loan remittances must be executed exclusively through the licensed-bank Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) monitored under the SBV balance-of-payments reporting system. Profit remittance hurdles for the LLC are: (1) completion of the annual corporate income tax finalization and settlement of all outstanding tax liabilities; (2) issuance of audited financial statements showing distributable post-tax profits and no accumulated losses; (3) a corporate resolution of the member approving the profit distribution; (4) registration of every DICA with the bank and declaration to the SBV; and (5) payment instruction via the DICA with conversion from VND to FX at the bank’s prevailing rate. No additional withholding tax is imposed on dividends or profit remittances to foreign shareholders (Vietnam abolished the profit-remittance tax; dividends are paid from after-tax profits). A decisive constraint for the golden-visa dimension of this business: outward remittances by a Vietnamese resident enterprise for the purpose of acquiring foreign real estate, residence-by-investment securities, or immigration-investment program participations are not recognized as permissible current-account payments under the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange. Such outbound capital movement requires, in law, an Overseas Investment Registration Certificate issued under Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP, which in practice is not obtainable for residence-advisory products. Therefore the VN_LLC must not route, hold, or settle client funds destined for foreign investment migration products; its lawful treasury model is limited to invoicing advisory/placement fees, holding student tuition money under a segregated escrow/trust arrangement only where permitted by its statutory license, and disbursing such money strictly to accredited educational institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vietnam does not currently impose a mandatory percentage conversion quota on export receipts; the effective surrender ratio for exporters, including service exporters such as an education-consultancy LLC, is 0%, meaning 100% of foreign-currency earnings from cross-border services (foreign university placement commissions and offshore consulting fees) may be retained in a Foreign Currency Account (FCA) at a licensed Vietnamese bank. The statutory discipline operates through repatriation and declaration rather than conversion: (i) all proceeds earned from services supplied by a resident enterprise to non-resident counterparties must be brought onshore into the FCA or DICA within the payment terms of the underlying contract and in any event by the annual audit cut-off; banks apply an internal monitoring window of approximately 12 months before classifying an unrepatriated receivable as a foreign-exchange irregularity; (ii) each inflow must be matched to the corresponding signed service agreement, service-completion certificate, export VAT invoice (if applicable under the VAT law on exports of services), and student placement documentation; and (iii) retained FX may be applied exclusively for permitted current-account disbursements (tuition payments to foreign universities, application fees, bank charges), spot-sold to the licensed bank for VND operating liquidity, or used as the base for permissible onshore hedging transactions. No statutory VND conversion floor or ceiling applies; the enterprise is free to retain its FX for subsequent lawful payments without a forced sale timeline. Non-compliance exposes the LLC to administrative penalties under Decree No. 88/2019/ND-CP (as amended) for unauthorized foreign-exchange activities, inaccurate balance-of-payments declarations, and offshore settlement outside licensed credit institutions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 January of each calendar year; newly established LLCs pay within 30 days after business registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to VND 10 million (approx. USD 410), daily late-payment interest at 0.03%, forced tax collection, and potential business registration revocation for prolonged non-payment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax finalization return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial General Department of Taxation via the General Department of Taxation e-Tax system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year-end; calendar-year LLCs must file by 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fines of approximately USD 80 to USD 410, daily late-payment interest at 0.03% on tax due, forced tax assessment, account garnishment, and possible enterprise registration revocation or administrative dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Taxation and, for foreign-invested LLCs, the provincial Department of Planning and Investment or investment registration agency
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year-end; calendar-year LLCs must submit by 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines for unaudited financial statements or late statutory filing, delayed tax clearance, blocked tax finalization, and repeated non-compliance may support administrative dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual employer personal income tax finalization return for retained employees
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial General Department of Taxation via the official electronic tax portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days from the end of the calendar year; return due by 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fines, daily late-payment interest at 0.03% on under-withheld PIT, and withholding of the corporate tax clearance certificate until finalization is complete.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit applies without size threshold to foreign-invested LLCs, including this entity. Audit is also compulsory for state-owned enterprises, public companies, credit, insurance, securities, fund-management entities, and large-scale domestic enterprises under Vietnamese enterprise accounting rules.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) and the enterprise accounting system prescribed by Circular No. 200/2014/TT-BTC; IFRS is permitted only in separately authorized consolidated reporting contexts and does not replace the statutory VAS financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vietnam does not require a separate annual UBO confirmation return. For any change of members or transfer of capital contributions, the LLC must update its Register of Members and notify the provincial Business Registration Office within 10 days of the change. As a licensed immigration/study-abroad advisory entity, it must also identify and verify beneficial owners under Vietnamese anti-money-laundering law before engagement and upon ownership changes; no annual government UBO filing is required.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members and Capital Contribution Transfers
Register of Directors and Legal Representatives
Corporate Minute Book and Decision Book

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard CIT rate of 20% applied to worldwide taxable income of the Vietnamese LLC. No sector-specific exemption for study abroad placement, immigration visa consultancy, or related advisory services under ISIC 7810. A preferential rate of 10% for 15 years is available only to qualifying new investment projects located in economic zones, high-tech zones, or approved industrial parks, subject to meeting the conditions set by the Law on Corporate Income Tax and Decree 218/2013/ND-CP; the service nature of this business will generally disqualify it from manufacturing-based incentives. Income from domestic dividends received by the LLC from a qualifying Vietnamese investee company is statutory exempt income. Quarterly provisional CIT payments must aggregate to at least 80% of the annual final tax liability; otherwise late payment interest of 0.03% per day applies to the shortfall.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 01/TNDN – Provisional Corporate Income Tax Declaration (electronic filing via the official General Department of Taxation e-tax portal etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn using the enterprise digital certificate)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the 30th day of the first month following the end of each calendar quarter; Q1 by 30 April, Q2 by 30 July, Q3 by 30 October, Q4 by 30 January of the following year

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax Identification Number (TIN) of the Vietnamese LLC
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the 13-digit TIN issued by the Provincial Tax Department at incorporation; no foreign TIN will be accepted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax period declared: quarter and year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Representative of the LLC selects the exact quarter and calendar year; non-resident shareholders have no separate filing period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enterprise name, registered office address, telephone number, and legal representative
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The legal representative or an authorised Vietnamese tax agent signs the declaration; the foreign owner may be listed as shareholder but must appear only in the related-party appendix.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue from business activities in the quarter
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all consulting fees, service commissions, and placement fees received from domestic and foreign clients; amounts routed through escrow must still be recognised on an accrual basis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-taxable income such as domestic dividend income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Immigration consultancy fees are fully taxable; only qualifying domestic dividends are excluded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible expenses incurred in the quarter
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses must be supported by valid VAT invoices, payment vouchers, and service contracts; intra-group management fees are deductible only if allocated under a written cost-sharing agreement and consistent with the arm’s length principle.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income for the quarter, calculated as revenue minus deductible expenses plus other income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A quarterly loss may be declared; the final CIT liability will be settled at annual finalization.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT rate applied and provisional CIT payable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the statutory 20% rate; no treaty rate is applicable to domestic CIT payable by the LLC itself.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalties under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP: warning for 1–5 days lateness; VND 2,000,000–5,000,000 for 6–30 days; VND 5,000,000–8,000,000 for 31–60 days; VND 8,000,000–15,000,000 for 61–90 days; VND 15,000,000–25,000,000 for more than 90 days or when under-declaration leads to insufficient payment. Late payment interest accrues at 0.03% per day on the outstanding tax amount.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 02/TNDN – Annual Corporate Income Tax Finalization Return (electronic filing via etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn, with attached audited financial statements and appendices including the related-party transaction declaration Appendix G)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 90 days from the end of the fiscal year; for calendar-year taxpayers no later than 31 March of the following year

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enterprise TIN and tax period of finalization
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: File under the LLC’s Vietnamese TIN; the foreign shareholder does not file a separate Vietnam CIT return on the LLC’s profits.
Indicate the fully licensed Vietnamese legal entity; no branch or PE designation is required for a domestic LLC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue from business activities for the full fiscal year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include all consulting fees, retainer incomes, migration processing fees, and escrow-released proceeds; revenue cannot be reduced by expenses paid to foreign introducers without valid documentation.
Exempt items such as qualifying domestic dividends are recorded here; service and advisory income is never exempt.

Substantiate rent, payroll, marketing, licensing, bank fees, and outsourcing costs with valid Vietnamese VAT invoices and foreign contractor tax documentation; the 20% cap on unreceipted expenses applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income from other activities such as securities transfers or capital assignment
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Separately disclose any disposition of contributed capital by the foreign shareholder if transacted through the LLC; capital gains may attract different CIT treatment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income before loss carryforward and preferential adjustments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Calculated as total revenue minus non-taxable income minus deductible expenses plus other income.
Only losses arising within the latest 5 consecutive years can be offset; immigration consulting losses cannot be carried back.
Standard rate 20%; any incentive rate must be evidenced by a valid investment certificate and registration of incentive regime with the tax authority.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT payable for the year and final reconciliation: total CIT, foreign tax credits, quarterly provisional payments, and balance due or refund
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The LLC must pay the residual CIT due upon filing; if total quarterly installments are below 80% of the final liability, late payment interest is charged on the difference.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Annual finalization late filing: VND 15,000,000–25,000,000 for submission after 90 days; additional penalty of 20% of the under-declared tax amount for incorrect declarations; late payment interest at 0.03% per day; criminal referral under Article 200 of the Penal Code for deliberate evasion exceeding VND 100,000,000.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% – Vietnam does not impose dividend withholding tax on profit distributions by a Vietnamese LLC to its foreign shareholders. After the LLC pays CIT at the entity level, after-tax profits may be distributed and remitted abroad without additional WHT, provided the audited financial statements are approved, the CIT finalization is completed, and no outstanding tax arrears exist.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Although dividend WHT is nil domestically, treaty relief for royalty, interest, and fee distributions requires the foreign recipient to obtain a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) from its home country tax authority and provide it to the Vietnamese payer before the payment date. The Vietnamese payer submits the TRC and a treaty relief application to the General Department of Taxation; withholding at the domestic rate is required if the TRC is not supplied in advance, and the foreign recipient may file a refund claim with the Vietnamese tax authority within 3 years from the date of payment. The TRC must state the recipient is resident in the treaty jurisdiction and beneficially owns the income.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid to non-residents for trademarks, software licences, know-how, or branding used by the visa advisory business are subject to Foreign Contractor Tax: 10% CIT plus 5% VAT on the gross royalty, producing a combined effective gross-up of approximately 17.65% of the net remitted amount. Interest paid to non-resident lenders is subject to 5% CIT and is VAT-exempt, giving an effective rate of 5.26% on a net remittance. Vietnam’s Double Tax Agreements generally cap royalty CIT at 10% and interest CIT at 10%, with newer treaties often limiting interest to 5% for banks and financial institutions; VAT is outside the scope of DTAs.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP, the Vietnamese LLC is exempt from preparing a Local File when its annual revenue is below VND 50,000,000,000 AND its total value of related-party transactions is below VND 30,000,000,000 in the same tax period. A Local File becomes mandatory when either threshold is crossed. A Master File is required when the group’s ultimate parent company, wherever resident, has consolidated annual revenue exceeding VND 3,000,000,000,000. A Country-by-Country Report is required when the consolidated group revenue of the ultimate parent exceeds VND 18,000,000,000,000 (EUR 750 million equivalent).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vietnam does not apply UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations; however, the tax administration applies a ‘substance over form’ doctrine through Article 5.2 of Decree 132/2020/ND-CP, disregarding related-party transactions where there is no economic substance, no commercial purpose, or the arrangement is artificial. The LLC must maintain real local personnel, physical office premises, a board of directors, an independent legal representative, and demonstrable control over the provision of visa and immigration consulting services. Payments out to shell affiliates are re-characterised, added back to CIT, and may trigger the anti-avoidance provisions of the Law on Tax Administration No. 38/2019/QH14.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Under-Declaration of Revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting client placement fees via overseas escrow accounts without invoicing; under-recording consulting revenue in the quarterly and annual CIT returns; registering the immigration advisory business under an incorrect code to claim a lower effective tax rate; destroying or falsifying client payment records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty equal to 20% of the under-declared tax amount plus late payment interest at 0.03% per day; where the evaded amount equals or exceeds VND 100,000,000, criminal prosecution under Article 200 of the Penal Code: individual legal representatives face fines up to VND 4,500,000,000 or imprisonment from 6 months to 7 years; the LLC itself faces fines up to VND 3,000,000,000, suspension of operations, and confiscation of illegal proceeds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The General Director and legal representative are jointly and severally liable for unpaid CIT, civil restitution of the State’s loss, travel bans prohibiting exit from Vietnam, and criminal imprisonment for intentionally directing or knowingly acquiescing in the suppression of revenue.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Mispricing and Intra-Group Service Fees
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying excessive management fees, referral commissions, or IP royalties to a related affiliate in Singapore, Hong Kong, or the Cayman Islands for nominal services; failing to prepare a Local File or Master File once the Decree 132/2020 thresholds are exceeded; concluding related-party contracts without contemporaneous documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Re-determination of taxable income by the General Department of Taxation at the arm’s length profit level; additional CIT assessed together with late payment interest at 0.03% per day and a 20% misdeclaration penalty; administrative fines up to VND 25,000,000 for failure to produce documentation; aggravated cases are referred to the criminal authorities for tax evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false transfer pricing reports or instruct artificial intercompany pricing are personally exposed to administrative penalties, civil restitution of the re-assessed tax, travel bans, and criminal prosecution where fraudulent intent is proved.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company, Sham Substance, and Illegal Invoicing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the LLC purely as a paper entity through which foreign investors obtain golden visas without genuine study abroad or residency advisory services; issuing or purchasing illegal VAT invoices; laundering client payments through the company account; declaring a non-existent headcount in filings; failing to submit annual audited financial statements for 12 consecutive months.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Cancellation of the enterprise’s tax code and business registration; disallowance of all expenses backed by counterfeit invoices; fines up to VND 500,000,000 for illegal invoicing; criminal liability under Article 204 of the Penal Code for issuing or using illegal invoices with imprisonment up to 20 years for organisers; the LLC may be subjected to revocation of the investment registration certificate and dissolution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The charter legal representative and Directors are personally liable to creditors and the tax authority, face civil restitution, prohibition from leaving Vietnam, confiscation of personal assets traceable to the sham scheme, and imprisonment for fraud, tax evasion, or money laundering.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML Non-Compliance and Escrow/Wire Payment Misconduct
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to perform customer due diligence and beneficial ownership verification on wealthy clients funding study abroad visas; accepting large third-party wire transfers into the escrow account without identifying the economic beneficiary; refusing to report suspicious transactions to the State Bank of Vietnam; using the LLC account as a conduit for foreign investor capital flight.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines of up to VND 400,000,000 under the Law on Anti-Money Laundering 2022 (effective 1 December 2023); freezing of escrow and bank accounts; if criminal money laundering under Article 324 of the Penal Code is established, the organisation is fined up to VND 5,000,000,000, suspended from operations for up to 3 years, and managers are imprisoned from 1 to 15 years depending on scale.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the compliance officer face personal fines, restrictions on holding management positions in Vietnam, exit prohibitions, confiscation of illicit assets, and criminal liability where they knowingly facilitated the laundering of client proceeds through escrow arrangements or wire transfers.
